1923, November
The following is a feitafil transcription of the handwritten origin- al notes by the Servant of God Fr. Solanus Casey OFM Cap. (his notebook NO. 1)
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
NOTES ABOUT SPECIAL CASES NOVEMBER, 1923
Page 1
Nov. 8th, 1923 Today Visitation colosed. Father Provincial wishes notes to be made of special favors reported as through the Seraphic Mass As- sociation.
1. Deo Gratias! This p.M. Marg. Quinn who enrolled her neighbor Mr. Maughan against drink and consequent anger October 26 as also her sister E. Remy of Philadelphia against severe inflamatory rheu- matism, reports "Wonderful improvement in former and letter this A. M. from sister - "Thank God and the Good prayer society I'm feeling fine".
Nov. 14 2. $100.00 bill found in letter-box with note: "Rev. Father I would like to have the names - Joseph Atkins and Agatha Atkins, both deceased, inscribed in the Mass Association. This offering is in their memory. Mary Halpine.
Feast of the Presentation. 3. "Danbury, Conn. Nov. 20th/23 Dear Fr. S. -- I wish to have my son enrolled in the Seraphic Mass Association. That God may give him the grace of a religious calling and strength and grace to ac- cept it - to God's greater honor and glory." Mrs. An. C. ---
4. Geo A. Kearn and Lena Marino - terribly beaten up - prospective Mem. ---
Nov. 28th 5. Nov. 28 Mrs. McCarthy 1559 Lexington Ave. "I have two partial strokes -- Husband drinks - (not to confession for) two sons drug- fiends - Member for year
Dec, 1st Mrs. Anna Grogan distracted - Daughter A. 16 yrs old had vanished a
Dec. 8th week before, enrolled for a year --- Reports Dec. 8th found next day in Jamica.
Dec. 8 Rose G. S(andler) nervous - brcke-down, has been home from business three weeks, asks for blessing of relic; joins S.M.A. instead for year.
Dec. 8 Miss Cath. A. Bartness - lost sight in right eye - joined for one year.
